label: TimeLodge Day Summary
info: Summarise the recorded and billable time in your TimeLodge workspace for one entry date. Configure TIMELODGE_AUTHORIZATION in the Node-RED process environment and edit the example date before clicking Inject.

name: TimeLodge Day Summary v0.1.0
info: Configure a TimeLodge workspace token scoped to time:read in the Node-RED process environment. Set TIMELODGE_AUTHORIZATION to Bearer followed by the token, then restart Node-RED if needed. Replace the example date in Select entry date, deploy and click Inject. The summary is available as msg.payload with entryDate, entryCount, recordedSeconds and billableSeconds.
